items.raw_excerpt: Jim and Carol Cook are now better known as the "Hacienda Hunters" for their love of finding Mexico's colonial ruins.
items.summary_en: Jim and Carol Cook travel across Mexico to find old colonial houses called haciendas. They want to bring these hidden ruins back to public view. Their trips have made them known as the Hacienda Hunters.
items.summary_ko: 짐 앤 캐롤 쿡 부부는 오래된 식민지 시대 저택인 아시엔다를 찾으며 멕시코를 여행한다. 이들은 잊혀진 유적을 사람들이 볼 수 있게 되살리고 싶어 한다. 이 여행 덕분에 두 사람은 하시엔다 헌터로 알려져 있다.
items.title_en: The Hacienda Hunters find Mexico's lost colonial houses

items.title_original: The ‘Hacienda Hunters’: Uncovering Mexico’s hidden history

items.raw_excerpt: Berlin Marathon winner Tigst Assefa has undergone surgery in Munich on Monday after finishing Sunday's race with a torn Achilles, her manager confirmed.
items.summary_en: Tigst Assefa won the Berlin Marathon on Sunday. She ran the whole race with a torn Achilles tendon. Her manager says she had surgery in Munich on Monday.

items.raw_excerpt: From the availability of fast food to technological advancements, Italy’s international residents say the country has been through some major transformations since they first arrived.
items.summary_en: Foreign residents in Italy say the country has changed a lot since they first arrived. They mention fast food chains, new technology, and more American-style ways of life. Some like the changes, and others worry about losing local traditions.
items.summary_ko: 이탈리아에 사는 외국인 주민들은 자기들이 처음 왔을 때보다 나라가 크게 변했다고 느낀다. 패스트푸드 체인 확대와 기술 발전, 미국식 생활 방식이 늘었다는 점을 든다. 이 변화를 좋아하는 사람도 있지만 전통이 사라지는 걸 걱정하는 사람도 있다.
items.title_en: Foreign Residents Say Italy Has Changed and Become More American
items.title_original: ‘More Americanised’: How foreign residents say Italy has changed
